# The opensecagent release that the container image takes (dev/agent-release.sh, docs/docker.md).
#
#   tag=vX.Y.Z
#   <SHA-256>  <file>        one line per file of that release: every package and its .sig
#
# The files are downloaded from https://github.com/tomCSLK/opensecagent/releases/download/<tag>/<file>, checked
# against the SHA-256 below and against the publisher key in keys/opensecagent.allowed_signers, and only then put
# into dist/agent/. Without a tag line the image has no packages (the pages of the computers offer only the scripts).
